items.title: Govt inks MoU with US firm to explore AI use in governance
items.description: Goa govt signs MoU with California’s Modern Data Company to explore AI for scheme delivery, education, tourism and healthcare planning using DataOS platform.

items.title: Goa to adopt AI governance to disburse government benefits and schemes
items.description: Goa partners with Modern Data Company to deploy DataOS AI for smarter governance, targeting benefits delivery, education, tourism, and healthcare.

items.title: IPB inks deals worth Rs 8,000 crore at Vibrant Goa summit
items.description: Goa IPB signs nine MoUs worth Rs 8,600 crore at Vibrant Goa summit, aiming to create 5,000 jobs in AI, data centres, energy, logistics and more.

items.title: AI Express flight crew's lapse probably led to runway incursion at Goa airport in Apr this yr: AAIB
items.description: The incident happened in the morning of April 3 involving Air India Express' Boeing 737-8 aircraft which was to operate the flight AXB 1109 from Dabolim to Delhi, and Navy's single pilot fighter jet

items.title: Tourism dept taps AI to promote Goa through online searches, drive international footfalls
items.description: Goa tourism department adopts AI to boost visibility in AI search and social platforms, promote year-round themes, and drive international footfalls.

items.title: North Goa hospital performs AI-assisted knee replacement surgery
items.description: North Goa District Hospital performs AI-assisted total knee replacement, enabling real-time guidance for accurate alignment and precise implant positioning in public healthcare.

items.title: GCCI pledges industry support to help build knowledge economy under Goa AI Policy
items.description: GCCI backs Goa AI Policy and Mission 2027, citing Rs 250 crore fund, 50,000 AI professionals by 2030, CoEs, school AI labs, and responsible AI rules.

items.title: State launches AI policy, to introduce AI fundamentals for Classes VI–XII from next academic year
items.description: Goa launches AI Policy 2026: AI fundamentals for Classes VI–XII from 2027-28, AI labs in 50 govt schools, and 50,000 AI-certified professionals by 2030.

items.title: Parties take the AI route to take potshots at their rivals
items.description: Goa parties use AI memes ahead of Feb 2027 Assembly polls as BJP and Congress trade digital attacks, raising questions about tech-driven campaigning.

items.title: Investment in data centres, AI city on Vibrant Goa summit agenda
items.description: Vibrant Goa Global Business Summit 2026 to spotlight NBCC-led investments in data centres and an AI city, plus India-Africa trade ties and MoUs.

items.title: IT dept aims to make 50,000 Goans AI certified by 2030
items.description: Goa IT dept targets AI certification for 50,000 people by 2030; AI Policy to launch at AI Tech Conclave Oct 22-23, with Konkani LLM and Bhashini focus.
